argv: iw dev wlan0 get power_save; nmcli -f GENERAL.CONNECTION,802-11-wireless.powersave con show netplan-wlan0-<wifi-ssid> 2>/dev/null | tail -1; iw dev wlan0 link | grep -E "signal|freq|bitrate"; uptime

date; echo "== boots"; journalctl --list-boots --no-pager 2>&1 | tail -5; echo "== throttled now"; vcgencmd get_throttled; echo "== last lines of previous boot"; journalctl -b -1 --no-pager -n 25 2>&1 | cut -c1-200; echo "== reset reason (this boot)"; journalctl -b 0 -k --no-pager 2>&1 | grep -iE "voltage|watchdog|reset|brown" | head; vcgencmd get_rsts 2>/dev/null; echo "== power supply"; vcgencmd pmic_read_adc 2>/dev/null | head -3; dmesg 2>/dev/null | grep -i -E "under-?voltage" | head -3

echo "booted at: $(uptime -s)"; cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id; journalctl -b 0 --no-pager -o short-iso 2>/dev/null | grep -m3 -E "^2026-10-21"; journalctl -b 0 --no-pager -u NetworkManager -o short-iso 2>/dev/null | grep -iE "wlan0.*(disconnect|state change|deauth|beacon)" | tail -8

argv: sudo nmcli connection modify netplan-wlan0-<wifi-ssid> 802-11-wireless.powersave 2 && echo "set powersave=2 (disable)"; nmcli -g 802-11-wireless.powersave con show netplan-wlan0-<wifi-ssid>; ls /etc/NetworkManager/system-connections/ /run/NetworkManager/system-connections/ 2>&1

ls -la /etc/netplan/; printf "# pinfer: disable Wi-Fi power save (latency spikes / DHCP blips), 2026-10-21
[connection]
wifi.powersave = 2
" | sudo tee /etc/NetworkManager/conf.d/90-pinfer-wifi-powersave-off.conf >/dev/null && echo "wrote conf.d drop-in"; cat /etc/NetworkManager/conf.d/90-pinfer-wifi-powersave-off.conf; sudo nmcli general reload conf && echo "NM config reloaded"; nmcli -g 802-11-wireless.powersave con show netplan-wlan0-<wifi-ssid>

argv: nmcli -f IN-USE,SSID,CHAN,FREQ,RATE,SIGNAL,SECURITY dev wifi list 2>/dev/null | grep -E "IN-USE|<wifi-ssid>"; journalctl -b 0 --no-pager -u NetworkManager -o short-iso --since "21:09" | grep -iE "wlan0" | grep -viE "^$" | tail -6

echo "== all BSSIDs for this SSID"; nmcli -f IN-USE,BSSID,SSID,CHAN,FREQ,SIGNAL,SECURITY dev wifi list --rescan no 2>/dev/null | grep -E "IN-USE|<wifi-ssid>"; echo "== reassociation events (whole boot)"; journalctl -b 0 --no-pager -o short-iso -u NetworkManager | grep -E "wlan0\): supplicant interface state: completed -> " | cut -c1-25,60-200; echo "== wpa_supplicant"; journalctl -b 0 --no-pager -o short-iso -u wpa_supplicant | grep -vE "^$" | tail -15 | cut -c1-220; echo "== kernel brcmfmac"; journalctl -b 0 -k --no-pager -o short-iso | grep -iE "brcmf|wlan0" | tail -8 | cut -c1-200
ip -br addr show eth0 wlan0; ip route | grep default; nmcli -t -f DEVICE,STATE,CONNECTION dev | grep -E "eth0|wlan0"

sudo nmcli connection modify netplan-eth0 ipv4.method manual ipv4.addresses 10.42.0.2/24 ipv4.gateway "" ipv4.never-default yes ipv6.method link-local && sudo nmcli connection up netplan-eth0 && echo "eth0 static applied"; sleep 2; ip -br addr show dev eth0; ip -br addr show dev wlan0; ip route; ls -la /etc/netplan/
